page0.text:
"Ha...ah!"
I pour all the strength I have left into my one good arm.
I try to grip the ground with my sticky, slippery arm and lever myself upright, even as I'm on the verge of literally splitting apart.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page0:1

page1.text:
"Hnnngh!"
For a brief second I see Saber's face.
She's on the brink of tears.
In that moment, I'm proud to know falling in love with her wasn't a mistake.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page1:1

page2.text:
"Hold it. It's not over yet."
I force myself up.
Neither of my legs work.
The magical energy that barely kept my body moving is gone.
All that remains is my faint heartbeat and the throbbing of my organs trying desperately to continue functioning.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page2:1

page3.text:
"Ah. Feeling regret, are we? I can hardly blame you. But that treasure is beyond you. I can hardly blame you for wanting to take it for yourself. That must make it all the more painful to see it in the hands of another man."
Too far. He goes too far.
I can't listen to another second of his shit.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page3:1

page4.text:
"Enough...quit talking about Saber like she's...just some thing to be claimed..."
I pour what energy I can into my right arm.
It feels like it's made of lead.
My body creaks and protests, but begins to obey.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page4:1

page5.text:
"Ha...aaa...ghhh!"
I push myself up to one knee.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page5:1

page6.text:
"Knhhh...damn...listen to...me!"
I take a deep breath, trying to focus what strength I have left.
Every time I move, I feel my organs shifting around as if with minds of their own.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page6:1

page7.text: "Why...why do you not understand that it is pointless!?"
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page7:1

page8.text:
Saber sounds like she's denouncing me.
She's far away.
In the distance, I can see her staring at me, sad and forlorn.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page8:1

page9.text:
"Ha...guh...aaah!"
I push everything from my mind to focus on making my body move.
Saber's voice is just a distraction.
Gilgamesh's laughter, the pathetic state my body's in...none of that is my biggest obstacle right now. Right now, it's Saber.
Hearing her say that, seeing her looking like that... It's almost enough to make me give up.
Finally...
I feel life flood into my knees. Now all I have to do is get to my feet.
"...I do not need it. I do not need your help. I have lost, and so I am no longer your sword.
It... It is only proper for me to disappear now!"
It's Saber's voice.
...Damn.
If you keep saying that... If you keep making this even harder, I'll get mad. Even at you...
"No...please stop, Shirou. You cannot keep going. Really...you will die. If you die this way...this way...I..."
Ungh...
Ugh, I can't keep listening to this. She has no idea how I feel!
"Shut up! Just be quiet for a minute! There's nothing wrong with relying on me at times like this!"
"That is wrong, Shirou. Please do not twist your priorities so!
You should not concern yourself with me. You must put your life ahead of mine!"
She's pleading with me.
Knowing that I'm responsible for the agonized sound of her voice makes me want to give up right now.
But...
"I refuse. There's nothing in the world I want more than you."
I can't allow myself to give in to her plea.
"What...?"
Saber gapes at me.
...I'm not sure why.
But I remember something.
She once told me I was a fool who didn't know the value of my own life.
I think she's right.
For someone who can't help themselves to try to help someone else is a little...presumptuous.
They're really only doing it for their own happiness, while the person they're meant to be helping may not be half so pleased.
Someone's first priority should be themselves.
The people who think like that are the ones who can be truly happy, and so they can then share that happiness with other people as well.
"Yeah. I know I'm a fool who doesn't value his own life."
I've been wrong about the most important thing in my life.
From that day...
...the place in my heart where whatever is most important to me should have been was empty.
But I'm grateful for that abnormality.
Because now, that empty space...
...is filled with the person I truly want to save.
"But Saber...even if I'm the most important thing in my life, nothing will change.
You are so much more beautiful than my life could ever be. Nothing could ever replace you in my heart."
And then I realize...
It wasn't that I was sympathetic towards her.
The girl in my dreams...
That girl who fought and died alone, who I felt was never rewarded for all she did... I was in awe of her.
I thought she was beautiful beyond words.
The vivid image of her taking her sword and charging into battle, never looking back, was awe-inspiring.
"Yeah. That's why..."
That's why I need to protect you, Saber.
You were alone your entire life, so I have to make sure you're not swallowed up by the darkness in your last moments.
...Yep. Once this is all over...on the verge of your death...
I hope you can go into your eternal slumber, proud of what you did with your life.
No more hesitation.
My objective is clear.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page9:1

page10.text:
"Sorry. I love you more than anything, Saber.
So I'm not letting him take you."
I regret the apology as soon as I give it.
But I wanted to tell her.
I wanted to tell her that, now of all times, because the words could come straight from my heart.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page10:1

page11.text:
...
I sense her gasping.
I want to turn around, to see her face, but no, I can't really see anymore anyway.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page11:1

page12.text:
I stand up.
As long as my heart is still beating, I can keep fighting.
Magical energy is life.
As long as it flows through me, I can create as many swords for her as she needs.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page12:1

page13.text:
"Congratulations. You've stood up. Now what? What do you expect to happen here?"
I feel a scorching heat in my right hand.
Here, on the brink of death, I'm reminded of what happened ten years ago.
...It's a terrible illusion.
I feel just like I did when I was in the fire, reaching a hand out and hoping to be saved.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page13:1

page14.text:
"Go away. I can't leave Saber to you."
I say that as I raise my right hand.
"Fool. I have no need for your consent."
Gilgamesh raises his sword.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page14:1

page15.text:
"Get down, Shirou!!!"
I hear Saber far behind me.
I ignore her and use my remaining magical energy to project a sword once more—
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page15:1

page16.text:
The light stops me.
A vortex of light rushes at me. It's not as strong as Excalibur, but it still burns away anything it touches.
...
When the heat scorches my body, I don't think about my death; I think about Saber, somewhere behind me.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page16:1

page17.text:
...
This will kill her as well as me.
I at least need to protect her, then.
I said it's what I'd do. It's...what I've always wanted to do.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page17:1

page18.text:
She's strong, but at the same time, could break at any moment.
She needs me.
She's like a drawn sword, so to make sure she doesn't get hurt, I'll sheathe her...
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page18:1

page19.text:
And then...
Before I realize what's going on, there's a sword in my right hand.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page19:1

page20.text:
"Wha...t!?"
I'm not sure who said that.
But there is a brief hesitation.
At the same moment, the invincible knight in gold takes a step backward.
"Shirou...allow me...!"
Saber takes my hand.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page20:1

page21.text:
The vortex of light fades.
Saber is right beside me.
Before me is Gilgamesh, eyes open...and bleeding.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page21:1

page22.text:
...
I don't know what happened.
But I realize it's just like the Berserker battle.
Saber is using whatever I made, and it destroyed Gilgamesh's Gram.
Two titanic beams of light collide before one overwhelms the other and we manage to truly wound the man who, until now, had been completely unscathed.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page22:1

page23.text:
...
He radiates murderous intent. It is terrifying.
In spite of that ferocious, murderous rage...
...the golden knight leaves without a word.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page23:1

page24.text:
"...Eh?"
But there's no time to be surprised.
I have no idea why he just left.
But, even as I feel myself slipping into unconsciousness, I know the battle's over.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page24:1

page25.text:
My knees buckle.
The tension that kept me upright fades, and I collapse.
"Shirou...!"
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page25:1

page26.text:
Saber hurries forward and catches me.
While I slip down onto my rear, supported by Saber, I look over my body.
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page26:1

page27.text:
"Ha..."
I can't help but cry out.
My body is torn to pieces.
"Ahhh...ha...haaa...ha..."
I should have been killed the instant Gilgamesh laid me open from shoulder to hip.
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page27:1

page28.text:
"Tch...ah...well this is definitely..."
My healing power must be what's got me clinging to life, but even that has its limits.
I'm practically split in two.
I can't possibly recover from this.
I'm not even sure if I'm breathing, and everything is starting to go dark.
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page28:1

page29.text:
My end is near.
The only good thing to come from this is that Saber is okay.
My wounds are fatal, but it looks like Saber was just exhausted.
She's disarmed, and her wounds are already healed.
Even if I end up having to drop out of the war, I'm sure Tohsaka can take care of the rest.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page29:1

page30.text:
I hear that sound again.
That sound of creaking bones...is coming from me.
Curious, I look down at my wounds.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page30:1

page31.text:
"...What?"
I see myriad swords.
Or...I see what looks like tons of tiny blades converging, layering atop each other, trying to knit together my broken body.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page31:1

page32.text:
I feel faint.
It looks like every muscle and bone in my body is made from...swords.
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page32:1

page33.text:
"Eh...?"
The next moment, they're gone.
My body looks normal, and what I thought I saw a moment ago seems to have only been an illusion.
As proof of that, my ruined flesh begins fusing together. My wounds close right before my eyes.
It's...more like restoration rather than healing.
Looking at it, I feel a surge of disgust rather than fascination.
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page33:1

page34.text:
"Wha...!?"
Looks like I'm going to make it.
But this is just too—
"What a relief. It appears you will not die, Master."
I hear Saber's voice at my ear.
She's, uh...really close.
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page34:1

page35.text:
"Uh...well, that's great. But my body...what's..."
I want to ask what's going on with my body, but I'm suddenly overcome with dizziness.
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page35:1

page36.text:
And then...
My body is enveloped in a soft embrace.
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page36:1

page37.text:
"Eh? S...aber...?"
"No. I understand now. It makes sense for your wounds to be healing."
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page37:1

page38.text:
I can't stay awake.
I produced too much magical energy. My worn out mind just wants sleep now.
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page38:1

page39.text:
I don't know how strong it is...
...but Saber moves closer and wraps her arms around me. She embraces me tight.
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page39:1

page40.text:
"I finally understand. You were my sheath, Shirou..."
Her words penetrate deep into my tired mind.
That sensation is so comforting, and the last of my remaining consciousness fades away.
I finally realize I'm safe, and so I yield my body to sleep.
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-04:page40:1
